## Logger.levelNames property

The names of the valid log levels.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static readonly levelNames: readonly LogLevel[];
```

## Remarks

They are in increasing order of verbosity, from `silent` to `all`<!-- -->.

The array is frozen. It is derived from the keys of `numericLevels`<!-- -->, so that the two cannot drift apart.

- added in v7.0.0

## Example


```javascript
console.log(`Valid levels: ${Logger.levelNames.join(', ')}`)
```
